newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LE TISSIER DIETING FOR ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LE TISSIER DIETING FOR ENGLAND.

text.p: England coach Glenn Hoddle and Southampton boss Graeme Souness have joined forces in a bid to help overweight Matthew Le Tissier secure an England place -- by losing weight.

Souness informed Hoddle that Le Tissier -- who stands 6ft 1 inches tall (1.85 metres) and weighs 13 stone 8 pounds (76.8 kg), was carrying extra weight -- so the duo have devised a plan to help him slim down.
Le Tissier now returns to the Dell every afternoon after his team mates have gone home to carry out a rigorous set of exercises.
Le Tissier has since lost five pounds (2 kgs), but Souness believes Le Tissier needs to trim another six pounds (3 kgs) before being fully fit.
Le Tissier said: "I don't mind coming back in the afternoons. If the manager thinks it will help me I am more than happy to go along with it."
